title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Little this week. There were no items on nirsevimab or infant RSV antibodies. RSV mentions fell from 29 to 17 and came from an overseas roundup of US and Indian seasonal-virus approaches, plus adult-focused lectures.
products.implication: The infant-antibody conversation is quiet, so there is room to prepare evidence rather than react. The earlier parent discussion about paying for infant antibody has faded.
products.action: Keep an evidence pack and stakeholder map ready for any future public-funding or eligibility discussion. Monitor parenting forums for renewed questions about self-pay cost.
products.signal_zh: 本週動態甚少。無nirsevimab或嬰兒RSV抗體相關內容。RSV提及數從29降至17，來自海外對美國與印度季節性病毒對策的綜整，以及以成人為主的講座。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒抗體討論沉寂，有空間預先準備實證而非被動回應。先前家長關於自費嬰兒抗體的討論已退燒。
products.action_zh: 備妥實證資料包與利害關係人地圖，以因應未來公費或適用對象討論。監測育兒論壇是否再出現自費費用疑問。
who_zh: 家長與孕產婦健康團體

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose vaccines are mentioned in CNA and other reports of the near 3.8 million public flu doses. ETtoday reports overall flu stock below half and mentions adjuvanted and high-dose options. Taipei's mayor directed stronger promotion of enhanced flu vaccines.
products.implication: With stock falling and second-stage eligibility opening on November 2, the first public season of enhanced vaccines may face questions on allocation, remaining doses and who outside long-term care can access them.
products.action: Prepare a factual supply and allocation briefing for Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus. Engage long-term care operators and geriatric clinicians on rollout experience. Have reactive lines ready on stock status, without making product claims.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），長照機構65歲以上公費
products.signal_zh: 中央社等報導公費流感疫苗近380萬劑時提及高劑量疫苗。ETtoday報導流感疫苗整體庫存不到一半，並提及佐劑型與高劑量選項。台北市長指示加強推廣加強型流感疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 隨庫存下降及11月2日第二階段開放，加強型疫苗的首個公費季可能面臨分配、剩餘劑量及長照以外對象能否接種等疑問。
products.action_zh: 為疾管署與地方衛生局準備客觀的供應與分配簡報。與長照業者及老年醫學臨床醫師交流推動經驗。備妥庫存狀況的回應說法，不做產品宣稱。
who_zh: 老年醫學與家庭醫學醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week. Tdap mentions fell from 6 to 3 and no item focused on Tdap or pertussis. The only related storyline is an earlier medical-society call on vaccines for chronic lung disease patients.
products.implication: There is no live public issue. Tdap is crowded out by the flu and COVID-19 campaign.
products.action: Maintain baseline monitoring. Keep relationships with obstetric and respiratory societies warm for later in the season, when the joint campaign news cycle eases.
products.signal_zh: 本週動態甚少。Tdap提及數從6降至3，無聚焦Tdap或百日咳的內容。唯一相關議題是先前醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 目前無進行中的公共議題。Tdap被流感與COVID-19疫苗宣導排擠。
products.action_zh: 維持基本監測。與婦產科及胸腔醫學會保持聯繫，待聯合接種新聞熱度在流行季後段趨緩時再推進。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax as a public COVID-19 option from October 19 and said it plans additional Novavax doses. Its pre-holiday call again lists Novavax as an option. News coverage mentions Novavax mainly in passing, and there are no Novavax-specific uptake figures.
products.implication: In its first weeks of availability, the practical questions are where Novavax is offered and whether stock reaches sites. Standalone attention is fading as overall COVID-19 volume falls from 287 to 182.
products.action: Work with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus so site-level availability information is accurate. Prepare a factual platform Q&A for healthcare professionals, not the public. Monitor COVID-19 safety posts that name no brand for any spillover.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，10月19日起公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗選項，並表示計畫追加Novavax疫苗。連假前呼籲再次列出Novavax為選項。新聞多僅順帶提及Novavax，且無Novavax個別接種數據。
products.implication_zh: 上市初期的實際問題在於哪裡提供Novavax、庫存是否送達各站點。隨COVID-19整體聲量從287降至182，單獨關注度逐漸下降。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局合作，確保各站點供應資訊正確。為醫療專業人員（非一般民眾）準備客觀的技術平台Q&A。監測未提及廠牌的COVID-19安全性貼文是否外溢。

issues.title: Second-stage eligibility opens as flu stock is reported below half
issues.note: Wider public eligibility on top of dwindling stock could bring shortage stories and questions about enhanced-dose allocation. Prepare supply facts with Taiwan CDC.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段開放之際，流感疫苗庫存傳已不到一半
issues.note_zh: 在庫存減少之際擴大公費對象，可能引發短缺報導及加強型疫苗分配疑問。與疾管署共同準備供應資訊。

issues.title: Public flu antiviral extension expires while the season stays active
issues.note: Taiwan CDC tied the extension to the ongoing epidemic period, and the Matsu cluster suggests continued activity. Watch for a further extension or a shift in messaging.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑延長措施到期，但疫情仍活躍
issues.note_zh: 疾管署將延長措施與持續流行期連結，馬祖群聚顯示疫情仍活躍。觀察是否再延長或訊息調整。

issues.title: Vaccine rumours recur after the debunked US military mRNA flu claim
issues.note: The rumour spread fast before Taiwan CDC rebutted it, and COVID-19 safety posts continue. Keep factual lines and HCP-facing materials ready, and defer to official rebuttals.
issues.title_zh: 美軍mRNA流感疫苗說法遭闢謠後，疫苗謠言可能再起
issues.note_zh: 該謠言在疾管署駁斥前迅速擴散，COVID-19安全性貼文也持續出現。備妥客觀說法與醫療專業人員資料，並以官方澄清為準。

self_pay.title: Self-pay mentioned alongside shrinking public stock
self_pay.note: Reports of public flu stock below half also reference self-paid options, but give no prices, brands or clinic stock levels.
self_pay.title_zh: 公費庫存減少之際，報導提及自費
self_pay.note_zh: 公費流感疫苗庫存不到一半的報導也提及自費選項，但未提供價格、廠牌或診所庫存。

self_pay.title: Outbreak areas may drive private demand
self_pay.note: Coverage of nearly 100 flu cases in Nangan, Matsu, mentions self-paid vaccination, a possible demand signal from people outside the eligible groups.
self_pay.title_zh: 疫情地區可能帶動自費需求
self_pay.note_zh: 馬祖南竿近百例流感的報導提及自費接種，可能是非公費對象需求的訊號。

self_pay.title: Silent on enhanced flu, RSV antibody and Tdap self-pay
self_pay.note: This week's items say nothing about self-pay availability, price or clinic promotion for adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines, infant RSV antibodies or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗、RSV抗體與Tdap自費無相關討論
self_pay.note_zh: 本週內容未提及佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗、嬰兒RSV抗體或Tdap的自費供應、價格或診所推廣。
